_meta.role: New Grad - Software Engineer, ML Ops

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building and deploying ML inference pipelines on edge robotics hardware. Optimized ONNX/TensorRT computer vision pipelines on NVIDIA Jetson for autonomous robotic systems, achieving real-time throughput under embedded resource constraints. Skilled in Python, C++, and ROS2, with end-to-end experience spanning dataset curation, model training, and edge deployment pipeline engineering.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset; trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images achieving 83% mAP@50; exported model to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment pipeline.
Built full dataset curation pipeline from raw images through labeling, training, and evaluation metrics.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built end-to-end PyTorch training pipeline using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.
Added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer for custom medical billing dataset; delivered deployable checkpoint.

experience.title: Research Intern
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline processing camera sensor data end-to-end: custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation achieving PSNR of 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth model for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction from camera data.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency via TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson; resolved 11 integration failures including false-positive detections and depth calibration.
Built a LeRobot-structured dataset curation pipeline using multiprocessing for synchronized multi-camera frame capture and telemetry logging.
Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini intent classification (<500ms); deployed three-layer edge pipeline: Flutter client → Flask-SocketIO server → Jetson+Arduino controller.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated dataset generation pipelines producing ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation using semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); achieved zero collisions and traffic light compliance across multiple laps in Town02 simulation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled VRAM and inference latency using pynvml with <1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
Evaluated model efficiency vs. task performance trade-offs to guide edge deployment pipeline decisions.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Deployed a Linux systemd service on Jetson Orin Nano (ROS2) with WebSocket auto-reconnect, SIGTERM/SIGINT handling, and serial passthrough; registered as production unit with Restart=always.
Built multi-route Flask/Socket.IO server handling device telemetry, command routing, STT transcription, and LLM intent classification across a 4-layer distributed robotics system.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
